messages:
Zoe Park: Heads-up 1 procurement (EMEA) pinged: they want to shorten to 9 months, pay in 3 equal installments (not monthly), insist vendor code + VAT number on invoices, and procurement wants to know if DocuSign is acceptable or if they need a wet signature. Redline: https://docsend.example/emerald-9mo
Hector Alvarez: Thanks Zoe. Can we support 3-installment billing? Finance usually handles monthly or one-time but installments are doable if PO specifies schedule. Need to confirm for rev rec.
Mina K.: Finance: 3-installments fine. We treat it as 3 invoices with amounts of total/3. Net60 on each invoice requires PO with vendor code and VAT ID. If they want Net90 for the last invoice, we need exec approval.
Priestley (Billing): Also need exact VAT format (e.g., GB123456789). If PO includes VAT number we will populate invoices. Otherwise tax team will push back.
Asha L.: Legal: DocuSign is acceptable for EMEA procurement generally, but one EU public entity asked for wet signature historically. Ask procurement which entity type. We can prepare both: DocuSign envelope and a PDF-ready wet-sign package.
Zoe Park: Customer response: "We're private corp, not public, so DocuSign ok. Procurement will send PO with vendor code EMR-443 and VAT GB99887766. They asked whether the SSO appendix (Okta) can be shown in the envelope pre-sign and whether SSO contact can be included on the invoice as a contact."

Hector Alvarez: Ok. Confirmed DocuSign allowed. We'll accept 3 invoices (each = total/3). What concession are they asking for?
Zoe Park: They asked for a 6% term concession on the 9mo total. ARR currently 300k -> 9mo pro-rate = 225k -> after 6% = 211,500 -> each installment = 70,500.
Mina K.: 6% concession within standard approval band for CSMs on mid-enterprise. Finance prelim approves if signed this quarter. No exec sign-off needed.
Priestley (Billing): PO template I sent them (they requested sample):
```
PO Number: _________
Purchasing Org: Emerald Labs Ltd.
Vendor Code: EMR-443
VAT Number: GB99887766
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Schedule: 3 installments (dates: 30/60/90 days from signature)
Payment Terms: Net60 per invoice (with PO)
Total Amount: 211,500 EUR
Billing Contact: billing@emerald.example
```
Asha L.: Legal will attach Okta SSO appendix as Exhibit A and add a short SSO contact attestation. We'll include a clause: "Procurement acknowledges exhibit displayed in DocuSign" so they explicitly see it before signing.
SignatureBot: Reminder created: follow up in 72h if PO not received.
Zoe Park: Customer replied: "PO routed to billing@redwood.example. Vendor code EMR-443 included. We'll review DocuSign once you send." :raised_hands:
Hector Alvarez: Once PO PDF arrives, Billing to queue three invoices per the schedule. Please attach PO to the first invoice and include VAT number on each invoice. CC @Priestley (Billing).
Priestley (Billing): Noted. After signed DocuSign + PO we will create installment invoices and attach PO to first invoice. Please include billing currency confirmation (they listed EUR). Also confirm payment rails (SEPA/Ach/wire).
Mina K.: Finance note: SEPA/wire preferred for EU accounts. If they pay card, we need separate setup and can't do Net60.
Zoe Park: I'll confirm currency and rails with procurement and upload PO when received. Marking thread in-flight.
SignatureBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 72h.
